name: Night At The Motel
storyline: The protagonist of the story has moved out of the family home a few months ago. He wanted to visit his parents, so he took his backpack and got into the car. Road was long and exhausting. Protagonist decided to spend the Night At The Motel to rest and recharge.
summary: Night At The Motel is a first-person horror experience and a walking simulator with exploration and conversation mechanics. Duration: Around 15 minutes
